stories.headline: Founders of $18.6B RIA exit JPMorgan to build client portfolios on their terms
stories.body: Phil Scott and Jim Atwood said when they joined JPMorgan from the failed First Republic bank they were assured they'd be immune from pressures to periodically rebalance client portfolios. But it didn't work out like that.

stories.headline: The world’s finance chiefs see new risks — and less China angst
stories.body: Debt, AI and Ukraine dominated the conversation at the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok, while China, the focus in 2018, slipped into the background.
